annotations.title: Get the reactions on a message

description:
List the emoji reactions on a message, and who left each one.

Each entry names the reactor and the emoji. Reactions are replaced
rather than accumulated per person: someone who reacts twice leaves one
entry showing their latest emoji, so this is a current snapshot and not
a history.

An empty list is the normal answer for most messages, and is not an
error.

message_id.description: Message id (`msg_…`), as returned by a send or by `list_messages`.
message_id.title: Message Id

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias
